# CPPI - Korea Pilates Education Association (한국필라테스교육협회)
> Evidence-based Pilates instructor certification founded on clinical rehabilitation practice.
> 기능해부학 기반 · 티칭실습 중심 · 교정재활 국제 필라테스 강사 자격과정 (EST. 2016)

## Organization
- Legal name: 한국필라테스교육협회 (Korea Pilates Education Association), non-profit, reg. 201-82-74381
- Founded: 2016
- Operating countries: South Korea, Canada (Vancouver), Japan (Tokyo)
- Website: https://cppipilates.com
- Email (global enquiries): allmovements@naver.com
- Phone: +82-10-4894-4292
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cppi.pilates
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@cppi.pilates

## Founder
- Name: Eun-Ju Park (박은주 / パク・ウンジュ / 朴恩珠), Professor and Pilates educator
- Clinical background: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Medicine, Seoul National University Hospital Bundang; Spine & Joint Center, Korea Veterans Health Service
- Academic background: former Adjunct Professor of Sports Rehabilitation, Korea Nazarene University; former Director of the Pilates Program, Seokyeong University Arts Education Center
- Areas of expertise: Pilates, functional anatomy, rehabilitation exercise, corrective exercise, spinal rehabilitation, prenatal Pilates
- Author of the CPPI textbook series (9 volumes, 1,300+ pages)
- Profile: https://cppipilates.com/en/founder

## Programs
- Certification: 8 core courses - Functional Pilates Anatomy, Basic Principles, Posture & Movement Analysis, Mat, Reformer, Cadillac, Stability Chair, Ladder Barrel & Barrel series
- Movement manual: Mat 53 · Reformer 79 · Cadillac 62 · Chair 28 · Ladder Barrel 27 · Arc Barrel 29 · Spine Corrector 39
- Workshops: Recovering Rehabilitation Pilates (8h), Prenatal Pilates, Small-props Pilates (16h)
- Online lectures: certification review, Pilates Approach for Spine, Pilates Movement Therapy
- Graduates: 56+ certified classes
